notes: FIXTURE catalog for the LEAF Phase 1 demand/growth kernels (leaf.growth, law stepwat_requested_support_v1). Every coefficient below is an UNCALIBRATED fixture chosen for a bounded readable example and for tests; none is a literature fit or a study calibration. Copy and edit; do not cite these numbers as species parameters.

allometry.notes: diameter_m = a_d * B^b_d ; height_m = a_h * B^b_h. Fixture coefficients. Biomass is NOT assumed proportional to canopy area; leaf.growth only receives the area derived through leaf.canopy.

roots.notes: shallow rooting: most roots in the top layer, some in the lower layer; root circle radius = 3 x canopy radius (uncalibrated fixture)

porosity.status: uncalibrated constant matching the current MAPLE default; used by native MAPLE wind, unused by LEAF ecology

growth.status: FIXTURE coefficients, not literature fits. intrinsic_rate_per_year must stay within the qualified [0, 1] weekly-Euler range.

units.mature_biomass_kg: kg dry aboveground mass per individual
units.biomass_support_kg_year_per_m3: kg*year of aboveground biomass SUPPORT per m3 of water (kg dry AGB supported for one year); not new biomass per m3, not a production yield, not a physical maintenance percentage
units.live_fraction: fraction of total dry AGB that is live
units.extra_growth_rate_per_year: 1/year: kg seasonal extra mass per kg*year of surplus support, range [0, 1]
units.temperature_*_c: degrees Celsius cardinal temperatures (factor 0 at/below min and at/above max, 1 at opt)

water_use.status: FIXTURE. Documented LEAF demand adaptation, not a STEPWAT daily-physiology claim.

units.transpiration_coefficient: dimensionless multiplier of canopy_area_m2 * PET_mm_per_day * 0.001 m/mm

life_expectancy.notes: metadata only; mean life expectancy, NOT a hard maximum age; no automatic death

units.burial: fraction of height buried per m

disturbance.notes: placeholders for later response laws; unused by leaf.growth

roots.notes: deep rooting: most roots in the lower layer, some in the top layer; root circle radius = 5 x canopy radius (uncalibrated fixture)

porosity.status: uncalibrated constant matching the current MAPLE default; used by native MAPLE wind, unused by LEAF ecology

water_use.status: FIXTURE. Per TOTAL dry AGB (live_fraction is not applied again). Documented LEAF demand adaptation.

units.demand_m3_per_kg_day: m3 of water per kg total dry AGB per day at reference PET
units.reference_pet_mm_per_day: mm/day PET at which demand_m3_per_kg_day applies

life_expectancy.notes: metadata only; mean, not a maximum

units.burial: fraction of height buried per m
